sloka: राघवस्य वचः श्रुत्वा परिष्वज्याभिपूज्य च ।अभिवाद्य ततो रामं ययौ सौमित्रिराहवम् ।। ६.५९.५१ ।।।।
transliteration: rāghavasya vacaḥ śrutvā pariṣvajyābhipūjya ca ।abhivādya tato rāmaṁ yayau saumitrirāhavam ।। 6.59.51 ।।।।

translations.english: On hearing Raghava's words, son of Sumitra embraced him and offered prayers, paying respects sallied forth for the encounter.
